|game_text=Deploy on table. Once per game, if Obi-Wan on table, may deploy Vader from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. |errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-03-I_Want_Every_Part_Of_This_Ship_Checked-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026; icons drawn as on the slip). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-iwanteverypartofthisshipchecked-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-03-I_Want_Every_Part_Of_This_Ship_Checked.png]]) show the original text (see [[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked]]).
* '''Original''' ([[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010): “Deploy on table. Once per game, if Obi-Wan on table, may ▼ Vader. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ a [Grabber]. If you just attempted to ▼ or ▲ a card, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card; reshuffle.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the original text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “If you just attempted to ▼ or ▲ a card” to “If you just attempted to take a card into hand or deploy a card from Reserve Deck” and “for that card; reshuffle.” to “for that card instead.”: “Deploy on table. Once per game, if Obi-Wan on table, may deploy Vader from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Used Pile to take a [Grabber] into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If you just attempted to take a card into hand or deploy a card from Reserve Deck, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card instead.”<ref name="cl-1271_10-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list writes the slip's icons out (▼ as “deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, ▲ as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”); that alone is not a version.
